target.title: feat(web): unify the app on a paper & ember design language
target.body:
One warm **"paper & ember"** design language across the whole web app.

The light theme already had a distinctive warm-paper identity, but it was polluted by leftovers from an earlier cool-toned design: purple/periwinkle brand gradients and glows, indigo quote blocks, Notion-blue settings buttons, a settings surface that reverted to the system font, and scrollbars that were invisible on light. The dark theme was a generic cool slate + periwinkle that didn't match the product at all.

## What changed

- **Espresso dark theme** — warm coal surfaces with a brighter ember accent replace the cool slate + periwinkle, so light and dark read as the same product (paper by day, espresso by night). The semantic agent colors are untouched: amber = working preamble, blue = delivered answer.
- **One accent story** — new `--brand-a/--brand-b` identity gradient (coral → raspberry) drives the home tile, auth mark, and empty-state icons; every glow/shadow now derives from the accent via `color-mix` instead of hardcoded periwinkle/pink.
- **Settings joins the family** — inherits Geist (previously reverted to the system font stack), ember primary buttons instead of `rgb(35,131,226)`, token-tied role pills/member avatars/radios/danger washes, and the previously **undefined `--surface` token** is now defined.
- **Token fixes** — quote blocks and reply affordances drop hardcoded indigo `#6366f1` and the undefined `--text-muted`; new `--accent-hover`/`--accent-contrast` tokens (dark text on the brighter dark-mode ember for proper contrast); theme-tied scrollbars.
- **Micro-polish** — the topbar channel `#` glyph and guild-rail active indicator pick up the accent; send-button hover deepens the ember instead of flipping to teal; sidebar section labels get refined tracking.
- **Dev fix** — the Vite proxy now forwards WebSocket upgrades (`ws: true`), so the local dev app connects to realtime instead of looping on "Reconnecting…".

CSS/token-only (plus the one-line vite proxy fix) — no markup or behavior changes, so e2e selectors and layout geometry are unaffected. `pnpm test`, `lint`, `fmt:check`, and both web/desktop typechecks pass.

## Before / after

### Chat — light

| Before | After |
| --- | --- |
| ![before chat light](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openclaw/clickclack/a013aae127cdd13ac56115ba2306d0a40cfa4ed4/.github/design-pr/before-chat-light.png) | ![after chat light](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openclaw/clickclack/a013aae127cdd13ac56115ba2306d0a40cfa4ed4/.github/design-pr/after-chat-light.png) |

The purple/magenta home tile and empty-state marks are gone; identity marks share the ember gradient, and the topbar `#` picks up the accent.

### Chat — dark

| Before | After |
| --- | --- |
| ![before chat dark](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openclaw/clickclack/a013aae127cdd13ac56115ba2306d0a40cfa4ed4/.github/design-pr/before-chat-dark.png) | ![after chat dark](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openclaw/clickclack/a013aae127cdd13ac56115ba2306d0a40cfa4ed4/.github/design-pr/after-chat-dark.png) |

Cool slate + periwinkle → espresso coal + ember. The amber preamble bar and blue delivery card keep their semantics and pop harder on the warm ground.

### Thread panel

| Before | After |
| --- | --- |
| ![before thread light](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openclaw/clickclack/a013aae127cdd13ac56115ba2306d0a40cfa4ed4/.github/design-pr/before-thread-light.png) | ![after thread light](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openclaw/clickclack/a013aae127cdd13ac56115ba2306d0a40cfa4ed4/.github/design-pr/after-thread-light.png) |
| ![before thread dark](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openclaw/clickclack/a013aae127cdd13ac56115ba2306d0a40cfa4ed4/.github/design-pr/before-thread-dark.png) | ![after thread dark](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openclaw/clickclack/a013aae127cdd13ac56115ba2306d0a40cfa4ed4/.github/design-pr/after-thread-dark.png) |

### Workspace settings

| Before | After |
| --- | --- |
| ![before settings light](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openclaw/clickclack/a013aae127cdd13ac56115ba2306d0a40cfa4ed4/.github/design-pr/before-settings-light.png) | ![after settings light](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openclaw/clickclack/a013aae127cdd13ac56115ba2306d0a40cfa4ed4/.github/design-pr/after-settings-light.png) |
| ![before settings dark](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openclaw/clickclack/a013aae127cdd13ac56115ba2306d0a40cfa4ed4/.github/design-pr/before-settings-dark.png) | ![after settings dark](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openclaw/clickclack/a013aae127cdd13ac56115ba2306d0a40cfa4ed4/.github/design-pr/after-settings-dark.png) |

The indigo workspace tile becomes the brand ember, and the whole surface now uses the app's Geist stack instead of the system font.

---

Screenshots are referenced from an intermediate commit on this branch (added then removed, so the merged tree stays clean); they were captured with an identical Playwright procedure against a seeded dev instance for both states.

target.title: feat: add collapsible sidebar sections
target.body:
## Summary

- make Channels, Direct messages, and People independently collapsible in the workspace sidebar
- replace decorative caret rows with accessible disclosure buttons using `aria-expanded` and stable `aria-controls` targets
- remember each section state per workspace in browser `localStorage`, with all sections expanded by default and safe fallback for malformed or unavailable storage
- preserve add-channel and start-DM actions while their lists are collapsed
- retain aggregate channel and DM unread visibility on collapsed headers, capped at `99+`
- preserve the existing whole-sidebar collapse, routing, selected conversation, and mobile drawer behavior

## Sidebar behavior

- each disclosure controls only its own list; collapsing Channels does not affect Direct messages or People
- navigating by URL, notification, or another control does not override an explicit collapsed preference
- disclosure state survives reloads and is isolated by workspace
- empty states, selected rows, DM action state, and unread data remain intact while their lists are hidden
- create controls remain separate sibling buttons, avoiding nested interactive controls and accidental disclosure toggles
- carets rotate in 140 ms and disable that transition under `prefers-reduced-motion`

## Accessibility and persistence contract

- section headings are native keyboard-reachable buttons with visible focus treatment
- `aria-expanded` always reflects the current state and `aria-controls` points to a stable mounted list container
- hidden lists use the native `hidden` attribute and are removed from layout and the accessibility tree
- persisted values use the versioned key `clickclack:sidebar-sections:v1:<workspace-id>`
- missing, malformed, partial, or inaccessible storage falls back to all-expanded without blocking sidebar interaction
- no server state, database schema, OpenAPI surface, SDK type, or OpenClaw channel contract changes

## Verification

- `pnpm --filter @clickclack/web typecheck`
- `pnpm lint`
- `pnpm fmt:ts:check`
- `pnpm build` — production web/SDK build and embedded asset refresh
- `pnpm exec playwright test -c /tmp/clickclack-playwright.config.ts sidebar-collapse.spec.ts` — 1 passed, covering independent disclosures, accessible state, `99+` unread aggregation, add actions while collapsed, reload persistence, per-workspace isolation, deep-link behavior, malformed-storage fallback, and the mobile drawer
- `go build -o /tmp/clickclack-sidebar-isolated ./apps/api/cmd/clickclack`
- live ClickClack `/healthz` passed after starting the candidate against the existing local database
- OpenClaw `/healthz` and `/readyz` passed; blackbird, clipper, dragon-lady, mustang, and nighthawk all reported `enabled, configured, running` after the controlled restart

## Real behavior proof

The attached eight-second screen recording was captured against the isolated production candidate running on the existing ClickClack database. It shows the real ClickClack workspace, connected status, existing channel set, and Blackbird person entry while Channels, Direct messages, and People are collapsed independently in the narrow sidebar layout.

The recording demonstrates that each disclosure hides only its own rows, directional carets update correctly, other sections remain usable, and the create-channel/start-DM controls remain available. Unread aggregation, persistence, workspace isolation, malformed-storage recovery, deep links, and mobile-drawer behavior are covered deterministically by the Playwright test rather than inferred from the recording.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/f07cb174-d29e-4386-8253-14a9215d9101


Reproduction details: [`docs/sidebar-collapse-behavior-proof.md`](https://github.com/jjjhenriksen/clickclack/blob/ebb1ce8/docs/sidebar-collapse-behavior-proof.md)

## Out of scope

- channel drag-and-drop or keyboard reordering belongs to a separate branch and is not included here
- no changes to unread calculation, read receipts, message delivery, notifications, or OpenClaw reply behavior
- no cross-browser account sync; disclosure preferences remain local to each browser profile
- no change to the existing whole-sidebar desktop collapse or workspace rail
